name: exact-part-receipt-gate-20260716
goal: Prevent catalog metadata, links, uploads, or manifest flags from self-promoting a sprinkler part to manufacturer-exact without byte-verified source, geometry, dimension, thread, kernel, collision, connection-fit, and render evidence.
exit_criteria: typed manufacturer and license metadata cannot set manufacturerExact true
remote mesh links remain catalog evidence with unverified remote bytes
a manifest file cannot self-assert manufacturer exactness
client-supplied hashes cannot promote exactness without an operator-controlled matching receipt
the server hashes every required local source and audit artifact itself
threaded parts require both a thread-standard source and modeled-thread geometry receipt
the server hashes the safe local render mesh itself and detects later tampering
a catalog item counts as dimensioned only after its source and dimension audit verify
the whole-system parity gate remains blocked independently of individual exact-part status
verification_gates: npx vitest run tests/part-override-api.test.js tests/parts-api.test.js tests/part-mesh.test.js in apps/autosprink
